If you want one partner to handle Instagram video content + Meta Ads + a trial-enquiry landing page, there are several North York/GTA options worth speaking to:

Qode Media — 4789 Yonge St, North York. Offers Meta/Facebook/Instagram advertising, social/content services, video production, web design and marketing automation. That makes it a fairly close match for an end-to-end setup.

Canada Create — 126 Willowdale Ave, North York. Full-service digital marketing with lead generation, paid advertising, creative/content and website work.

1800Marketing Lead Generation — 114 Fisherville Rd, North York. Specifically positioned around done-for-you lead-generation systems, including Facebook/Instagram Ads, landing pages, automation and multimedia/video.

NORTH MARKETING — Toronto-based, with a stronger emphasis on social content/video, influencer marketing and paid social. Their site shows examples of short-form video production and Instagram/TikTok work. 
NORTH MARKETING

SOCIAL SHERPA — 85 Curlew Dr, North York. Focuses on social/content plus paid acquisition for small and service businesses, including promo-video and website work.

Particularly relevant if it's a gym/fitness studio

H2O Digital Marketing Inc. is farther west in Concord, but its published experience includes Orangetheory Fitness, with paid social programs for fitness studios across North America.

There's also The Marketing Mavericks, which specifically markets Meta Ads to Toronto fitness centres and gyms, combining short-form creative, targeting, conversion tracking and landing-page alignment around trial enquiries. 
Marketing Mavericks

Another fitness-specific option is Red Leaf Media, which explicitly works with gyms, fitness studios and personal-training businesses on trial offers, training content and paid ads connected to landing pages. 
Red Leaf Media

For your exact brief, I'd ask each agency for a proposal covering these three deliverables together:

8–12 Reels/month — filming/editing at the gym, coaches, classes, member stories and offers.

Meta lead campaign — Instagram/Facebook ads targeted around the North York catchment area, with proper Pixel/Conversions API tracking.

Trial landing page — one focused page with the offer, social proof, FAQs and enquiry/booking form, with leads routed immediately to the gym.

That lets you compare agencies on the whole lead funnel, rather than hiring someone who only makes nice Instagram videos or only manages ad accounts.

If you tell me your monthly budget (e.g. $2k, $4k, $6k+) and whether you want them to physically come to the gym to film, I can narrow this to the most suitable 3 and compare their published pricing/services.

ChatGPT can make mistakes. Check important info.
